description: List every wiki page in a course, returning page stubs — title, url slug, published state and editing_roles — without the HTML body; the paginated list endpoint omits body entirely. Use get_page to fetch one page's full body by its url slug, or search_course_content to search page content across the whole course. Fetches every page (100 per request) and fails with a 'Results are incomplete' error instead of silently truncating.
name: list_pages
title: List Pages
